description: One-DGX Spark Tencent Hy4 flash in Baekpica's mixed-precision GGUF (Q5/Q4 experts, Q8_0 dense projections, FP8 Engram tables read from SSD) on Baekpica's ds4-dfm-rs, the Rust-host continuation of DwarfStar (antirez ds4), built from the engine commit the creator names (commit 25bf4b8f, upstream PR #159, merged, pinned by full sha). MTP drafting with the DFly2 Q8_0 head at depth 2, native 1,048,576-token context, one request at a time, KV snapshots on local disk (16 GiB), text and image input through the BF16 projector. The Engram tables are read with O_DIRECT; the sandbox blocks io_uring, so the engine falls back to serial page reads and Engram prefill reads are slower than the creator's. The KV cache directory maps the creator's ~/.cache to the platform's writable cache. The memory peak follows the creator's own MQ-Q5-Q8 run on GB10, which left at least 7.56 GiB available of 130.66 GB at a 1,048,542-token request (docs/hy4-flash-mxq.md line 37), less the 2 GiB system floor.
title: Hy4 flash MQ-Q5-Q8 ds4-dfm-rs single Spark (Baekpica)
